findings.issue: IN and OUT plaques both point screen-right; exterior rail chevrons also do not consistently distinguish inward receiving from outward dispatch.
findings.repair: Use plain IN/OUT plaques or perspective-correct opposite flow cues. Remove ornamental rail chevrons so no cue contradicts the port role.

findings.issue: Rear food sleeves are low in exterior view, while food mechanism enters at prepared-food shelf height above raw cabinets in section. There is no depicted vertical lift between them.
findings.repair: Choose one coherent design: raise exterior rear cassette to shelf elevation (record this explicit proposal change) OR show separate local lifts from low ports. Match interface elevations in exterior and section.

findings.issue: Food section shows entry on left side wall and exit on right side wall, while exterior puts both sleeves side by side in the rear wall. It is a different topology.
findings.repair: Redraw the close section with two parallel sleeves through the same rear plane, distinct receiving/dispatch trays and one local shuttle; retain rear vent and closed raw cabinets.

findings.issue: Utility cutaway depicts incoming tray/lift but does not expose a connected internal dispatch position for the separate OUT lane.
findings.repair: Expose both receiving and release positions tied to the same left-bay mechanism without crossing center aisle.

findings.issue: Incoming timber is a rectangular plank bundle but the depicted timber bay is only logs; outgoing gray stone is paired with a visible MATERIALS bin containing silver ingots. Multiple stored SKUs could be valid, but their indexed handoffs are not visible.
findings.repair: Show matching demonstrated SKU in its actual receiving/retrieval compartment (planks and gray stones) or clearly separate indexed per-SKU bins; never imply form conversion during storage.

findings.issue: Advanced house front doors/apron, left window, rear vent and right fuel hatch remain recognizable. Exterior dock additions are supported and front approach is clear.

required_repairs: Same rear food port plane and elevation inside/outside
approval_boundary: Exact static storage proposal only; no automatic six-zone storage, footprint/world-fit, working inventory or native mechanism approval.
